¿Cuántas facturas vigentes tiene el cliente 0000000150?

SELECT COUNT(*) AS facturas_vigentes
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.serie, LPAD(TRIM(f.numfac), 10, '0'))
           f.serie,
           LPAD(TRIM(f.numfac), 10, '0') AS folio,
           f.cliente,
           f.status
    FROM faccab f
    ORDER BY f.serie, LPAD(TRIM(f.numfac), 10, '0'), f.fcaptura DESC NULLS LAST
) ult
WHERE TRIM(ult.cliente) = '0000000150'
  AND ult.status = 'V'

Ventas de 2003 por moneda.

SELECT
    UPPER(TRIM(f.ref1)) AS moneda,
    COALESCE(SUM(NULLIF(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(f.total), '$', ''), ',', ''), '')::numeric), 0) AS total_ventas
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'))
        serie,
        LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0') AS folio,
        status,
        fecha,
        ref1,
        total
    FROM faccab
    ORDER BY serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'), fcaptura DESC NULLS LAST
) AS f
WHERE TRIM(f.status) = 'V'
  AND TRIM(f.fecha) BETWEEN '20030101' AND '20031231'
  AND UPPER(TRIM(f.ref1)) IN ('MXN', 'USD')
GROUP BY UPPER(TRIM(f.ref1))
ORDER BY moneda

Cuenta las facturas canceladas del año 2004.

SELECT COUNT(*) AS facturas_canceladas_2004
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.serie, LPAD(TRIM(f.numfac), 10, '0'))
           f.status,
           TRIM(f.fecha) AS fecha
    FROM faccab AS f
    ORDER BY f.serie, LPAD(TRIM(f.numfac), 10, '0'), TRIM(f.fcaptura) DESC NULLS LAST
) AS u
WHERE u.status = 'C'
  AND u.fecha BETWEEN '20040101' AND '20041231'

¿Cuál fue el total de la factura 0000001096 de la serie A?

SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(f.total), '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric AS total
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.serie, LPAD(TRIM(f.numfac), 10, '0'))
           f.serie,
           LPAD(TRIM(f.numfac), 10, '0') AS folio,
           f.status,
           f.total
    FROM faccab f
    WHERE f.serie = 'A'
      AND LPAD(TRIM(f.numfac), 10, '0') = '0000001096'
    ORDER BY f.serie, LPAD(TRIM(f.numfac), 10, '0'), f.fcaptura DESC
) f
WHERE f.status = 'V'
